title: Chat or code snippet
description: A short excerpt in the channel's one box form, dark (ink at 90 %, 24 px rounding), never a whole screen and never chat bubbles: mode "chat" shows at most three messages as name and text (the assistant's name in the highlight colour, its text typed out); mode "code" shows at most max_lines lines with line numbers, a marked line gets a thin highlight band with ink type at the cue. Body font throughout (mono: true for a monospace code font). On an overlay the box sits on the free side next to the face; with "transparent": false it is centred on the paper ground.

params.title: Claude Code

cues.land: typed text is complete here; a marked code line gets its band

notes: messages: [{"who": "user" | "assistant", "text": ...}], at most 3, short. highlight: line numbers (from 1) of code lines to mark. cps: characters per second of typed text (raised so typing is done by the cue).
